closed.what: Wired LexerTokenCache into FeelAstCache.get_or_parse (was orphaned dead code); added bounded FIFO eviction to both LexerTokenCache and FeelAstCache (max_entries=10_000). Tests: get_or_parse_warms_lexer_token_cache + bounded eviction.

Fixed structurally-non-functional nightly regression gate: scripts/memcheck-gate.sh (single source of truth), memory_baseline writes v6.0-current.json (no longer overwrites frozen v6.0-baseline.json), --update-baseline opt-in, Makefile memcheck/baseline-update, bench.yml uses make memcheck + installs jq. Verified pass/fail/missing cases.

Memoized DRD topological order on SharedDmnModel (drd_order_cache, cleared on bump_generation); resolve_drd_order_cached used by evaluate. Cycle detection unchanged. Tests: drd_order_is_memoized + bump_generation_clears_drd_order_cache.

Level-by-level parallel DRD evaluation via rayon. New resolve_drd_levels (topo levels) + evaluate_single_decision (non-recursive, lock-free). evaluate rewritten: levels processed in order (barrier between levels), >1-decision levels use par_iter, single-decision levels stay sequential. One outer read guard; &SharedDmnModel shared into rayon tasks (Sync). Added rayon=1.10. Tests: resolve_drd_levels_groups_diamond, diamond_parallel_eval_produces_correct_result (d1->{d2a,d2b}->d3, result=118), chain_eval_sequential_levels. TCK sweep + hit_policy_core/advanced + dmn_round_trip + feel_cache_wiring all pass. Plan: 39-01-PLAN.md.

Expanded vendored TCK corpus 21->51 Level 3 dirs (target 35+) from upstream dmn-tck/tck@0dbcaf9, covering FEEL built-in families (numeric/string/list/context/relational/temporal). cargo test --test tck_sweep green: 51 vectors, 123 layer-passes, 0 failed. Documented 30 remaining evaluator-layer gaps (parse+round-trip pass, evaluator output not yet matching) in TCK-COVERAGE-GAPS.md grouped by DMN 1.5 section 10.3.4 family as future FEEL built-in roadmap. Plans: 39-02-PLAN.md + TCK-COVERAGE-GAPS.md.

Per-thread thread_local! L1 FEEL-AST cache (Weak<FeelExpression>) shadowing the shared DashMap in get_or_parse. FEEL text->AST is pure so keyed by (entry,content) is correct across reloads/instances. Live L1 hit returns the SAME Arc with no shard-lock; dead Weak falls through to shared map. Bounded FIFO 1024/thread. Also FIXED latent harness bug: engine/Cargo.toml dmn_benchmarks harness true->false (criterion_main! was shadowed by libtest; make bench measured nothing). New bench_feel_cache_concurrency group: thread_local vs dashmap_contended at 16/32 threads. Results: 11.1x speedup @16t (3.87ms vs 43.18ms), 16.1x @32t (7.59ms vs 122.56ms) — target 4-20x MET. 5 new cache tests; all 15 cache + tck_sweep + feel_cache_wiring + hit_policy_core green. Plan: 39-03-PLAN.md.

Zero-copy DMN XML loader: removed the per-element BytesStart::into_owned() copy from every streaming dispatch loop below the root. into_owned() re-copied element name + every attribute byte per start event (thousands/doc), defeating zero-copy and duplicating collect_attrs work. Each loop now reads a borrowed Event::Start(e), extracts owned local-name String (+ owned Attrs map only in recurse arms), drops the borrow; NLL ends e's borrow at last use so the recursive &mut self parse is sound. read_event_into ties event lifetime to &mut self.reader. Sub-parser signatures changed &BytesStart -> pre-collected owned data: attrs: Attrs (20 methods), parent: &str (5), end_local: &str only (2), none (parse_dmndi_block). Public API unchanged. Single into_owned() exception = root <definitions> (one alloc/document; namespace resolution needs &self.reader while qname live but borrowed event holds &mut self.reader). New test parser_zero_copy_preserves_attrs_cdata_and_entities. Behavior preserved: dmn_round_trip 14/14, dmn_parser 8/8, hit_policy_core 5/5, hit_policy_advanced 9/9, tck_sweep 51, feel_cache_wiring 6/6. Bench harness confirmed measuring: parser corpus_all = 6.07ms median. Plan: 39-04-PLAN.md.

Benchmark verification: parser/corpus_all shows -22.49% change (≥20% target MET). FEEL evaluator: per-thread L1 cache 11.1x speedup @16t. Memory baseline re-baselined from 29→60 files to match expanded TCK corpus. make memcheck passes with 0% RSS/alloc regression.
